g.text: Pin names and D numbers are copied from that image (Dn = Arduino label). Pin numbers 1-26 are ours.

g.desc: Pin names and D numbers are copied from that image (Dn = Arduino label). Pin numbers 1-26 are ours.

g.text: BATTERY+ appears twice on the front, as on the image. When P0.13 is set low, power to 3.3V is cut off.

g.desc: BATTERY+ appears twice on the front, as on the image. When P0.13 is set low, power to 3.3V is cut off.

g.text: Back pads (SWC, SWD, P1.01, P1.02, P1.07, BOOST) are named as on the image; their positions here are approximate.

g.desc: Back pads (SWC, SWD, P1.01, P1.02, P1.07, BOOST) are named as on the image; their positions here are approximate.

g.text: BOOST: bridging the back jumper raises the charge rate from 100 mA to 500 mA (only for batteries > 500 mAh).

g.desc: BOOST: bridging the back jumper raises the charge rate from 100 mA to 500 mA (only for batteries > 500 mAh).
